prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preview Your Desktop Companion", "See how your pet interacts with desktop windows before completing adoption.", "Looks Great!"]
1: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Learn desktop controls and hotkeys to move, talk to, or minimize your pet anytime.", "Start Playing"]
2: ["Discover Your Perfect Desktop Pet", "Scroll through pet personalities to find the perfect adoption path for your desktop."]
3: []
4: ["Save Your Companion to Cloud Sync", "Sign in to securely sync your desktop pet, custom traits, and progress across sessions.", "Prevents pet reset when logging in again or changing devices."]
5: ["We are preparing your pet's desktop overlay. Please keep the app running in your system tray."]
6: ["Tip: Right-click your pet or system tray icon anytime to access controls, switch modes, or hide your companion."]
7: ["Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack!"]
8: ["Customize Your Desktop Friend", "Select traits on the left and preview your pet live on the right."]
9: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "Asset loading takes a moment. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop!"]
